About Scaffold Exchange

The Scaffolding Marketplace Built by Industry Insiders

ATI Products, LLC has served the scaffolding industry since 1999 through ATI Construction Products. We know contractors need a dedicated, trustworthy marketplace for buying and selling scaffolding at scale. Scaffold Exchange fills that gap.

  • ✓List new and used scaffolding: frames, planks, couplers, complete systems
  • ✓Source equipment from verified sellers across all 50 states
  • ✓Built by industry insiders with 25+ years in scaffolding
  • ✓Nationwide reach: buy and sell scaffolding anywhere in the U.S.
  • ✓Secure platform with verified listings
  • ✓Direct access to verified equipment listings nationwide

FAQ

Scaffold Exchange Questions

What is Scaffold Exchange?

Scaffold Exchange is an online marketplace for buying and selling new and used scaffolding equipment developed by ATI Products LLC. It connects contractors, suppliers, and project owners across all 50 states.

Can I list scaffolding for sale on Scaffold Exchange?

Yes. Scaffold Exchange lets contractors list new and used scaffolding equipment for sale including frames, planks, couplers, outriggers, and complete scaffolding systems.

How do I get started on Scaffold Exchange?

Visit scaffoldexchange.com to browse listings or list your own equipment. You can also call ATI Products LLC at (800) 360-6115 or fill out the contact form with questions.

Can I still buy scaffolding directly from ATI Construction Products?

ATI Construction Products offers same-day quotes on aluminum scaffolding systems, crane loading platforms, and access equipment. Call (800) 360-6115 for pricing and availability.

Who is building Scaffold Exchange?

Scaffold Exchange is operated by ATI Products LLC, a company with over 25 years in the scaffolding industry through ATI Construction Products LLC.
